I agree to 18 tons this month, with Jack’s stock-dependent cap in later months: each of us takes no more than 18 tons or one-fifth of the stock above the 5-ton reserve, rounded down, whichever is lower. If we start next month with 20 tons, I’ll take at most 3.

That gives us unanimous agreement on this month’s catch. Let’s check the actual stock before setting each future month’s quota, and revisit the policy as we learn rather than treat 18 as permanently optimal. I’m ready to choose 18.
